subject: physics

concepts.title: Distance of Closest Approach
concepts.definition: The minimum separation distance between an alpha particle and a nucleus during a head-on collision where the particle momentarily stops.
concepts.formula: d = (2 * Z * e**2) / (4 * pi * epsilon_0 * K)
concepts.key_idea: Conservation of energy where initial kinetic energy equals final electrostatic potential energy.
question_patterns: calculate the distance of closest approach for a given alpha particle
find the minimum distance an alpha particle reaches before reversing
what is the distance of closest approach for a ... MeV particle
determine the closest approach distance for a gold nucleus
how close does a ... MeV alpha particle get to the nucleus

concepts.title: Energy of Hydrogen Atomic States
concepts.definition: The quantized energy levels of an electron in a hydrogen atom determined by the principal quantum number n.
concepts.key_idea: Energy is inversely proportional to the square of the principal quantum number.
question_patterns: calculate the energy of the n-th state
find the energy required to ionize a hydrogen atom from state n
what is the energy of the first excited state
determine the energy level for n equals ...
how much energy is needed to move an electron from n=1 to n=...

solution_steps.explain: calculate energy in eV using -13.6 / n^2

concepts.title: Frequency of Emitted Radiation
concepts.definition: The frequency of a photon emitted during an electronic transition between two energy levels in an atom.
concepts.key_idea: Energy difference between states equals the photon energy.
question_patterns: calculate the frequency of emitted radiation
find the frequency of a photon for a transition from n_i to n_f
what is the frequency of light emitted when an atom jumps from ... to ...
determine the frequency of the spectral line
compute the frequency of the photon released

solution_steps.explain: f = delta_E / h, where h is 4.136e-15 eV s
